about.title: About me
paragraphs: I am a passionate Web and Mobile Development student with experience in building web and mobile applications using modern technologies.
I enjoy solving problems, learning new skills, and developing innovative solutions. Through academic and personal projects, I have strengthened my technical, analytical, and teamwork abilities.

Beyond code, I create digital content: video editing, graphic design and music production. I am motivated to keep learning, contribute to impactful projects, and grow as a software engineer in an international environment.
